voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: This is collections from the other side of the desk.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Meet Priya. She runs collections for a lender.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Nine a.m. Priya opens Kairos, coffee in hand.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Today's plan is already done:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: who to contact, when and how. Nothing to set up.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Then she just watches the score.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Runs are rupees collected. Run rate: money per hour, against today's target.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Partnerships: the channels at work. Wickets: rule breaches. Zero, all day.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Extras: money saved on messages that wouldn't have worked.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: And ball by ball, the commentary says what Kairos did, and why.

voices.speaker: Priya
voices.text: Zero wickets, again.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Only the big calls come to her.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Someone lost their job. Kairos suggests a gentle call from a senior colleague.

voices.speaker: Priya
voices.text: Approve.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Aladdin re-checks before anything goes out.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Everything else, at her fingertips:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: any borrower's story in one click, and why each decision was made,

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: the lender's reports, ready-made, and what Kairos is learning.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Six p.m. Match result.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Against the fixed schedule, Kairos brings back about twice the money per rupee.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Player of the match: evening WhatsApp. Wickets: zero.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Priya closes the laptop, and goes home on time.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Kairos. Collections on autopilot. You just watch the score.
